text:
mike_sales: FYI we're at the final stage with RippleHealth POC. Legal flagged the DPA sub-processor language and procurement needs the signed order form routing clarified. Can we align on what we can accept?

omar_soleng: Thanks — quick summary of asks from their side: (1) list of sub-processors or a commitment to notify 30 days in advance, (2) SLA latency buckets in ms for 95th percentile, (3) add finance contact for PO cc on DocuSign.

tess_legal: We're okay with a 30-day notice for new sub-processors but they'll insist on a standing list for SOC2 auditors. Proposed compromise: provide a current sub-processor list as an appendix + contractual 30-day notify for additions. Also they redlined MSA section 6.2 (data processing) to require vendor-level indemnity — we pushed back.

lucy_security: For the security questionnaire they asked for KMS/HSM details and whether keys are customer-managed in Private deployments. We can confirm: hosted API uses our KMS; for Private we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM. I'll paste the snippet they want into the order form.

anna_finance: For PO routing: they want the DocuSign envelope to route to their Accounts Payable after our signature. If we pre-fill `Invoice contact` we need to ensure our billing team is cc'd. Suggest: add `billing@redwood.com` as BCC on the envelope and `finance@ripplehealth.com` as routing step 2.

mike_sales: I uploaded the editable order form here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/OrderForm_Ripple_v3.pdf (internal copy). Major redlines are in the order form under Pricing & SLA. Their legal sent a countersign with 2 changes: net45 -> net30 and a penalty on uptime < 99.9%.

omar_soleng: On SLA: we typically offer 99.9% for hosted, Dedicated can be 99.95 with committed capacity. We should avoid hard monetary penalties in the order form; propose service credits tied to downtime minutes, capped at 50% of monthly committed spend. Example clause to propose (feel free to copy):
```
If Redwood fails to meet the Monthly Uptime Commitment, Customer will be eligible for a Service Credit calculated as a percentage of the monthly fees for the affected service, not to exceed fifty percent (50%) of such monthly fees.
```

tess_legal: That clause looks fine. For DPA sub-processors I'll draft an appendix and propose this text: "Current sub-processors listed in Appendix A; Redwood will provide 30 days' prior notice for material additions. Customer may object in writing within 14 days on reasonable grounds." Keep objections narrow to avoid infinite negotiation.

lucy_security: Also add this line to the order form security section: "For hosted deployments, data at rest is encrypted with AES-256; key management is handled by Redwood KMS. For Dedicated and Private, customer-managed KMS is available and recommended for regulated PII workloads"

mike_sales: DocuSign routing question: can we automate the routing so legal signs first, then finance, then customer AP? docsign-bot any blockers?

docsign-bot: Automated envelope template `redwood-orderflow-v2` exists. Workflow: 1) Redwood legal sign (role: Redwood_Signer), 2) Redwood billing (role: Billing_CC) as cc, 3) Customer exec sign, 4) Customer AP (routing to specified email) — we can set net payment terms field. Need final signatory emails and PO number to prefill.

anna_finance: I'll provide `billing@redwood.com` and PO number once customer confirms. Recommend sending invoice wiring instructions as separate encrypted PDF.

omar_soleng: One more technical note — customer asked for per-route latency SLO. We can include a table for their POC routes: small-chat: p95 < 120ms, embeddings: p95 < 220ms (hosted, eu-west). Add these as non-binding profile numbers in the order form appendix.

mike_sales: Action items: (1) @tess_legal to attach Appendix A draft + DPA sub-processor list, (2) @lucy_security to paste the KMS blurb into order form, (3) @anna_finance to confirm billing email & PO field, (4) @omar_soleng to insert SLA/service credit language and per-route p95 table, (5) I'll confirm DocuSign signatories and send envelope template.

tess_legal: I'll get Appendix A and redline back by EOD today.

lucy_security: Adding KMS blurb now.

anna_finance: Will confirm billing email by EOD and loop accounting.

omar_soleng: I'll update the order form and ping for review when done.

mike_sales: Thanks team — I'll notify the customer that we're preparing the updated order form and routing steps. :thumbsup:

---
Notes: keep copies of the signed order form in SFDC under opportunity 6742 and attach Appendix A to the contract record.
